name: PTX Metals Inc.
summary: PTX Metals Inc., together with its subsidiaries, acquires, explores, evaluates, and develops mineral properties in Canada. The company explores for gold and platinum group elements. It primarily holds interests in the Shining Tree gold property with 139 claim units covering an area of 2,299 hectares located in Ontario. PTX Metals Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Newmarket, Canada.
